coordinateSystem.name: Equirectangular with standard parallel 27 degrees north
coordinateSystem.note: Uniform local geographic scale at 27N; north-south distances are not squeezed into a panorama. Longitude distortion varies modestly with latitude.

warning: Actual anchor positions are distinct from enlarged illustrated footprints. No marker coordinates from v1/v2 are compatible. Unverified geographic anchors are explicitly flagged.
